crossRefs.note: The pride of Israel testifies to his face; yet they haven’t returned to Yahweh their God, nor sought him, for all this.
There is a generation, oh how lofty are their eyes! Their eyelids are lifted up.
The look of their faces testify against them. They parade their sin like Sodom. They don’t hide it. Woe to their soul!…
All the people will know, including Ephraim and the inhabitants of Samaria, who say in pride and in arrogance of heart,
“The bricks have fallen, but we will build with cut stone. The sycamore fig trees have been cut down, but we will put…
Woe to the crown of pride of the drunkards of Ephraim, and to the fading flower of his glorious beauty, which is on the…
Everyone who makes a carved image is vain. The things that they delight in will not profit. Their own witnesses don’t…
For our transgressions are multiplied before you, and our sins testify against us; for our transgressions are with us…
Though our iniquities testify against us, work for your name’s sake, Yahweh; for our rebellions are many. We have…
Therefore you testify to yourselves that you are children of those who killed the prophets.
“He said to him, ‘Out of your own mouth I will judge you, you wicked servant! You knew that I am an exacting man…
You will stumble in the day, and the prophet will also stumble with you in the night; and I will destroy your mother.
Israel, return to Yahweh your God; for you have fallen because of your sin.
The righteousness of the blameless will direct his way, but the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness.
Most certainly, the evil man will not be unpunished, but the offspring of the righteous will be delivered.
The wicked is brought down in his calamity, but in death, the righteous has a refuge.
for a righteous man falls seven times and rises up again; but the wicked are overthrown by calamity.
“The virgin of Israel has fallen; She shall rise no more. She is cast down on her land; there is no one to raise her…
For I will be to Ephraim like a lion, and like a young lion to the house of Judah. I myself will tear in pieces and go…
For Israel has forgotten his Maker and built palaces; and Judah has multiplied fortified cities; but I will send a fire…
Also Judah didn’t keep the commandments of Yahweh their God, but walked in the statutes of Israel which they made.
Yahweh rejected all the offspring of Israel, afflicted them, and delivered them into the hands of raiders, until he had…
You have walked in the way of your sister; therefore I will give her cup into your hand.’
Yahweh says: “For three transgressions of Judah, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment; because they have…
but I will send a fire on Judah, and it will devour the palaces of Jerusalem.”

people.name: Ephraim
people.line: Second son of Joseph, and a tribe of Israel.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: The pride of Israel testifies to his face. Therefore Israel and Ephraim will stumble in their iniquity. Judah also will stumble with them.
translations.bsb: Israel’s arrogance testifies against them; Israel and Ephraim stumble in their iniquity; even Judah stumbles with them.
translations.kjv: And the pride of Israel doth testify to his face: therefore shall Israel and Ephraim fall in their iniquity; Judah also shall fall
translations.asv: And the pride of Israel doth testify to his face: therefore Israel and Ephraim shall stumble in their iniquity; Judah also shall stumble with them.
